text.brief: On March 24, 2023, the foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said that authorities suspected the Mintz Group of illegal business operations.
text.record: Police had raided the American due diligence firm's Beijing office days earlier and detained its five local employees. In April security officers questioned staff at Bain's Shanghai office ([CNN report on the Mintz Group fine, syndicated by KTVZ (media only)](https://ktvz.com/?p=1204106)). In May state television accused the expert network Capvision of helping foreign spies. The revised Counter-Espionage Law took effect on July 1, 2023, and widened espionage to cover documents and data related to national security ([Xinhua: China revises Counter-Espionage Law (NPC English-language site, April 27, 2023)](https://subsites.chinadaily.com.cn/npc/2023-04/27/c_882140.htm); [A&O Shearman (law firm): the revised PRC Counter-Espionage law, what has really changed](https://www.aoshearman.com/en/insights/the-revised-prc-counter-espionage-law-what-has-really-changed)). The city's statistics bureau fined Mintz about $1.5 million in August.
text.reading: The Party closed the firms that verify supply chains and counterparties at the moment American law began to require that verification, so due diligence itself became a risk of espionage. The mainland employees who served as the investors' eyes bore the arrests, which is Stratagem 22.
text.gapText: Data Architecture. American compliance rules assumed investors could verify facts on the ground, and the Party made verification a crime.
text.fix: Treat an inability to verify as a finding in its own right, and require disclosure when due diligence becomes impossible.
